Jo tumhe impossible lagta—wo kaam tumhe karna padega.
Grit gehri hai.
Grit vijeta ko paribhashit karti hai.
Chup rehna gyaan ki shuruat hai.
Courage dar ka virodh hai, dar par kabja, dar ki kami nahi.
Tabhi bolo jab aapka bolna khamoshi se behtar ho.
Brave fear ko driver nahi banate.
Duniya sabko tod deti—phir kai log tootey jagahon pe strong ban jaate.
Khamoshi wisdom ke liye jagah banati.
Grit lachila-pan hai.
Khamoshi aadhar hai.
Himmat badi hai.
Pressure me steady raho.
Hum sab ek saans door calm.
Sher ki dahad tez hoti hai, lekin uska chup rehna daravna hota hai.
Grit pressure mein strength hai.
Dusron ki opinions humein define na karein—yeh decide karein.
Khamoshi behtar sunne ka pul hai.
Chuppi samajhdaaron ka kavach hai.
Himmat bina takraar ke discipline hai.
Silence sabse powerful scream hai.
